threads.body: This duplicates protocol configuration that is now being enforced globally in `AbstractTestContainerManager` via `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL`. Keeping both increases the chance they drift (e.g., a future change updates one but not the other). Prefer relying on a single source of truth (either remove the script-level override if the manager always applies, or make the manager skip setting it for tests that explicitly set it themselves).

`OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL` does not switch `DeclarativeConfigurationSmokeTest`: `smoke-tests/src/test/resources/declarative-config.yaml` explicitly selects `otlp_grpc`, so that smoke suite continues exporting over gRPC. To complete the stated switch to HTTP, update that declarative exporter to `otlp_http` and give it the signal-specific `/v1/traces` endpoint.
